boards.title: Your First Weekend at Ohio Northern University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-based, under-21-safe sequence built from ONU’s current Welcome Weekend and student-life information.

cards.title: Start by signing the Spirit Rock
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend arrival stop
cards.notes: Find the Spirit Rock during move-in programming, add your signature if the event is offered, then use the nearby campus activity as an icebreaker.
cards.short_summary: A documented Welcome Weekend stop for new Polar Bears.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists Spirit Rock Signing for new Polar Bears at the Spirit Rock.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Participate when Welcome Weekend programming schedules the activity.

cards.title: Get oriented at McIntosh Center
cards.subtitle: Check-in, services, and gathering point
cards.notes: Use the center as a practical first stop: confirm your schedule, locate student-facing offices, and note the dining hall before heading to other events.
cards.short_summary: A central Welcome Weekend check-in and campus-services location.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists McIntosh Center’s Activities Room for student ID, parking, commuter, and transfer Welcome Weekend check-in tasks.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Use the event schedule and posted office information for current access.

cards.title: Share a meal at McIntosh Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Inside McIntosh Center
cards.notes: Plan a meal-window meet-up here, then keep the conversation going by choosing one afternoon program or campus walk together.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s primary campus dining gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies McIntosh Dining Hall in McIntosh Center as its primary gathering place and describes its all-you-care-to-eat dining environment.
cards.access_notes: Food requires an applicable meal plan or purchase; check current dining service information.

cards.title: Locate English Chapel between sessions
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend program venue
cards.notes: Walk over while the campus is active and identify the sanctuary entrance so future student-life or academic sessions are easy to find.
cards.short_summary: A named venue used in ONU’s new-student schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s Summer Orientation schedules student-life and academic sessions in the English Chapel sanctuary.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled programs or visit in accordance with university access practices.

cards.title: Make Heterick your study rendezvous
cards.subtitle: Library and student-resource stop
cards.notes: Pick a seat, test the route from your residence hall, and save the library contact details for research help once classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with study spaces and student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU describes Heterick Memorial Library as an updated facility with open study spaces, huddle rooms, and student library resources.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current posted hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a library refresh break
cards.subtitle: Retail café at Heterick
cards.notes: Pair a short café stop with a library orientation: identify a study area first, then return with any drink or snack you purchase.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus retail dining option at the library.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU lists Northern Lights Café among its on-campus retail dining locations and its accepted-student guide places it in Heterick Library.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; verify current service hours before relying on it.

cards.title: Walk the Green Monster
cards.subtitle: Campus outdoor track
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk or ride with a new classmate, using the full route as an easy way to see more of campus without a fixed agenda.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU identifies the Green Monster as an emerald-green outdoor campus track for walking, biking, or rollerblading and states it is 2.5 miles long.
cards.access_notes: Use in daylight and follow posted campus recreation and safety guidance.

cards.title: Find King Horn Field House
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and convocation venue
cards.notes: Orient yourself to the field house during an open program, then note its fitness, court, track, and pool facilities for later recreation plans.
cards.short_summary: A named campus athletic and recreation complex.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s accepted-student guide describes King Horn as a complex with cardio and weight rooms, sports courts, an indoor track, and a pool.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreation availability can vary; consult current university information.

cards.entity_name: Freed Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check the Freed Center calendar
cards.subtitle: 525 South Main Street
cards.notes: Look for a student production or public performance, save the venue location, and make a plan with friends once tickets or entry details are confirmed.
cards.short_summary: ONU’s performing-arts venue for student productions and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freed Center says student productions fill its season and lists its address as 525 South Main Street in Ada.
cards.source_title: Freed Center at ONU | Performing Arts & Musical Theater | ONU
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and timing vary by event; consult the current calendar or box office.

cards.title: Try an SPC event with your floor
cards.subtitle: Recurring student-programming option
cards.notes: Ask your residence-hall group what SPC has scheduled, choose an age-appropriate event, and use it as a low-pressure way to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A documented source of weekly student entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU’s accepted-student guide describes the Student Planning Committee as a student organization that provides free weekly entertainment for students.
cards.access_notes: Event format, location, and eligibility vary; use the current student event listing.
